english_source_note: Uniform Distribution mod 1 and Weyl's Criterion
english_title: Second Example of a Sequence Not Uniformly Distributed Modulo 1
statement_en: Let $r_n$ be an enumeration of the rational numbers in $[-\frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{2})$, and define $$\xi_n:=\begin{cases}r_n&100\mid n\\0&\text{otherwise.}\end{cases}$$ Then $(\xi_n)$ is not uniformly distributed modulo $1$. For example, for a fixed interval such as $[\frac{1}{5},\frac{1}{4}]$, among the first $N$ terms at most $N/100$ lie in this interval, so the limiting proportion is at most $1/100$, not the interval length $1/20$. Nevertheless, the set of values of the sequence is dense in $[-\frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{2})$.
key_techniques: construct a sparse perturbation of a dense set
compare limiting frequency with interval length
callout_body:
假设$r_n$是对$[-\frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{2})$之间的有理数的一种枚举方式。然后定义$$\xi_n:=\begin{cases}r_{n}&100|n\\0&\text{otherwise}\end{cases}$$比如考察区间$[\frac{1}{4},\frac{1}{5}]$，前$N$个序列$\xi_n$的元素当中有不超过$N/100$个元素落在此区间里面。于是最后比例的极限肯定是小于等于区间长度$1/4-1/5 = 1/20$的。不过和之前的例子不同的是，此序列在$[-\frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{2})$当中是稠密的。

这里我们虽然用$100|n$这个条件增加了$\xi_n =0$的频率，减少了其落在$[-\frac{1}{2},0),(0,\frac{1}{2})$的频率，但是因为有理数的稠密性，序列$\xi_n$对应的集合依旧是稠密的。
